newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani rice prices seen firm on foreign demand.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani rice prices seen firm on foreign demand.

text.p: Pakistani rice export prices are likely to rise next week on exporter demand, dealers said on Thursday.
Prices of IRRI-6 variety rice firmed following demand from exporters who want to fulfill export contracts.
Basmati super export prices were rising slowly on expectations of higher demand from abroad, the exporter said.
Pakistan exported 1.717 million tonnes of rice worth $460 million during 1996/97 (July-June), compared to 1.6 million tonnes worth $504 million in the same period a year ago.
In June, rice exports fell to 86,488 tonnes worth $28 million compared to 151,568 tonnes worth $39 million in May and 347,471 tonnes worth $93 million in June 1996.
